annotations.title: Autonomous Agent Pre-Execution Command & Prompt Injection Gate

description: Evaluates untrusted agent prompts, bash commands, and tool arguments to block prompt injection, destructive shell commands, and private-key exfiltration. Use when screening a general shell command or user prompt before agent execution; for statically validating SQL database queries at the AST level, use validate_sql_query_ast instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'payload' ('action_type' defaults to 'bash_command'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

action_type.description: Execution context of the payload; defaults to 'bash_command' when omitted.

payload.description: Raw command string, script snippet, or untrusted prompt to inspect for safety violations.

name: verify_agent_command_safety

safe.description: True when zero injection, exfiltration, or destructive patterns are found.

threats_detected.description: List of specific threat categories triggered by the payload.
